seal.statement: Make report classification refuse unsupported evidence. the retained failed formation is classified as a failure; valid success is recognized; missing, malformed and conflicting reports cannot print healthy or produce a pass receipt. Existing correctly classified report families retain their meaning. Test the public triage/receipt path, not only a normalization helper.

text: Contract-before-edit decision for Quest canonical-report-outcome-classification: The canonical report classification contract replaces the naive scenarios[0]-only assumption and permissive CLASS_SLOW default with explicit boundary conversion across supported report families: stat-gate scenario reports (scenarios[0]), service-data-affinity formation reports (formationVerdict and standardSummary.scenarios), and topology refusal records (outcome: 'refused', refusal). Empty reports ({}), unobserved reports lacking verdict fields (passed === null without metrics or signals), malformed objects, and contradictory evidence (formation PASS with failed summary/scenarios, formation FAIL with passed summary/scenarios, passed === true with hard invariant breaches, or unsupported verdicts) fail closed into a typed CLASS_UNJUDGEABLE outcome. Retained formation failures map directly to failure classes (STALLED for node_ready_lease_incomplete, seed_event_loop_starved, schema_admission_blocked; TOPOLOGY_BLOCKED for critical_system_spread_open; ORACLE_BLIND for seed_log_unavailable), preventing failed formations from masquerading as healthy SLOW. In scripts/triage-distributed-failure.js, scenario names are resolved across scenarios, standardSummary.scenarios, and scenario; UNJUDGEABLE guidance is emitted with non-zero exit (code 1), REFUSED exits with code 2, and 'run classified healthy — nothing to triage.' is strictly prohibited for unjudgeable, refused, or failed runs.

Attempt 1: Implemented canonical outcome contract across report families in scripts/rolling-restart-stat-gate-summary.js and scripts/triage-distributed-failure.js. Exported CLASS_UNJUDGEABLE and CLASS_REFUSED, added domain constants and structured result builders (buildUnjudgeableResult, buildFormationSuccessResult, buildFormationFailureResult, buildRefusedResult). Updated classifyStatGateScenario to detect unobserved verdict fields and contradictory hard breaches rather than defaulting to CLASS_SLOW. Implemented classifyFormationReport to validate consistency and classify formation PASS (CONVERGED) and FAIL (STALLED/TOPOLOGY_BLOCKED/ORACLE_BLIND). Updated scripts/triage-distributed-failure.js to handle multiple schema families, add UNJUDGEABLE guidance, exit non-zero for unjudgeable/refused runs, and avoid false healthy classifications. Added evidence harness scripts/quest-evidence/canonical-report-outcome-classification.js and 4 functional witness tests in test/scripts/rolling-restart-stat-gate-summary.test.js. Measured genuine red probe (0/5 passing), verified green functional receipts (4/5 passing, with independent-verification awaiting verifier), and cleared all 6 static audits with 0 violations.

Independent Argon verification (templates: owner-interaction, harness-fidelity): APPROVE. Inspected producer/classifier/consumer boundary across examples/service-data-affinity/{formation-verdict,affinity-demo-live-report}.js, scripts/rolling-restart-stat-gate-summary.js, and scripts/triage-distributed-failure.js. Verified that empty {}, null, non-object, unobserved scenarios, unknown formation verdicts, and contradictory reports (formation PASS with failed summary/scenarios, formation FAIL with passed scenarios, passed=true with hardBreaches>0) fail closed as CLASS_UNJUDGEABLE; retained failed formation (node_ready_lease_incomplete / seed_event_loop_starved / critical_system_spread_open / seed_log_unavailable) classifies as failure (STALLED / TOPOLOGY_BLOCKED / ORACLE_BLIND) and never SLOW or CONVERGED; triage CLI exits non-zero on UNJUDGEABLE/REFUSED and never prints healthy. All 5 required receipts and 6 static quality gates pass.
